name: Sika Plug
paste:
SIKA® PLUG: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Plug, December 2025, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/0/sika_plug.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Plug where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Plug is a chloride free, ready for use powder based on high alumina cement. When mixed with water Sika® Plug becomes a rapid setting plugging mortar.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Plug is a chloride free, ready for use powder based on high alumina cement. When mixed with water Sika® Plug becomes a rapid setting plugging mortar. Sika® Plug can be used to seal leaks as a pre-treatment to the installation of Sikalastic 1K cementitious waterproofing syetem.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Plug
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Cementitious fast setting water plug
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (December 2025, Version 01.03) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS1478.2: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Compressive strength (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Easy to use and mix just add water.
    - No Special equipment required.
    - Rapid setting and high early strength gain.
    - Excellent adhesion to mineral substrates.
    - Rapid water-stopping capacity and hydraulic resistance.
    - No cracking and very low shrinkage.
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: High Alumina cement
    - Appearance and colour: Grey Cement powder
    - Density: 2.0kg/litre (mixed) approx.
2.6 Compressive strength.
    | 6 hours | ~ 10 MPa | (AS1478.2-A) |
    | 1 day | ~ 12 MPa |
    | 7 days | ~ 18 MPa |
    | 28 days | ~ 25 MPa |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Note printed: Material and curing conditions at 23°C / 50% r.h. The above results are based on 50mm x 50mm cubes
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 10kg plastic bucket
    - Shelf life: 12 months in unopened original container.
    - Storage conditions: Storage in dry warehouse conditions.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (December 2025, Version 01.03) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: 3 parts powder : 1 part water; (approx. by mass)
4.3 Initial set time.
    | Water Temp. (⁰C) | Initial Set (seconds) |
    | 5 | 150 |
    | 10 | 110 |
    | 15 | 85 |
    | 20 | 70 |
    | 25 | 60 |
    | 30 | 50 |
    | 35 | 45 |
4.4 Further documentation.
    - Under certain conditions of warm to hot ambient temperature in the prescense of water for prolonged periods, hardened high alumina cement undergoes a chemical process known as "Conversion" resulting in a loss of mechanical strength. Sika® Plug is therefore not recommended for medium to long term structural repairs and should be overcoated with and used as part of the Sikalastic 1K waterproofing system.
    - Prepare Sika® Plug in small quantities at a time. If mixed in arge quantities hardening may occur prior to application.
    - Do not mix other cements or admixtures with Sika® Plug.
    - Sika® Plug is hygroscopic. Seal any unused material immediately in the original container.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (December 2025, Version 01.03) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Plug, December 2025, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/0/sika_plug.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® Plug, version 17/03/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/3/sds-sika-plug.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. Refer to manufacturer. This is not stated in the data sheet reviewed (December 2025, Version 01.03).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
